episodes.synopsis: Dog is a pure optimist who holds out hope that today might be the day Sensei shares her snacks with him...
episodes.title: Every Day Is Fun

episodes.synopsis: After a rough day at work, Sensei is cheered up when Dog shoves a ball in her face. Even Cat shows concern for her in his own way.
episodes.title: They're Both So Sweet

episodes.synopsis: While taking Cat to the vet via taxi, Sensei listens as the driver tells her about the cat he used to have.
episodes.title: In the Taxi

episodes.synopsis: Sensei recalls what Dog and Cat were like when they were little.
episodes.title: When They Were Little

episodes.synopsis: Dog once managed to spill the container his food is kept in, and he still tries to knock it over every day, optimistically hoping it will spill again. Cat, on the other hand, doesn't wait around for happy accidents.
episodes.title: Will It Come Out Today?

episodes.synopsis: Dog gets so excited by all the attention he gets at the vet's office, he doesn't even realize he's been given a shot. Cat, however, is less excitable...
episodes.title: The Vet

episodes.synopsis: A conversation with her editor reminds Sensei of the dog she had before taking in her current dog and cat.
episodes.title: My Previous Dog

episodes.synopsis: When Dog breaks free while on a walk, all Sensei has to do to bring him back is sing and dance. Cat, however, is not so easily lured in...
episodes.title: Sing and Dance

episodes.synopsis: Sensei has no trouble understanding Dog's love of being petted. With Cat, it's all in the ears.
episodes.title: The Ears Never Lie

episodes.synopsis: Sensei has been trying out a new game with her dog and cat lately, and their reactions are quite different...
episodes.title: Playing

episodes.synopsis: Sensei recalls the dog she had as a child and reflects on how every pet has its own unique personality.
episodes.title: The Dog Before the Previous Dog

episodes.synopsis: Sensei recalls how her cat reacted to her previous dog and does a little research into what his past behavior meant...
episodes.title: What It Means

episodes.synopsis: Sensei recalls the days when she volunteered at a dog shelter... which happened to take in cats sometimes, too.
episodes.title: Volunteer

episodes.synopsis: Dog and Cat express their emotions in very different ways when Sensei returns home after being away for long periods.
episodes.title: I'm Home

episodes.synopsis: Dog and Cat celebrate their birthdays in slightly different ways...
episodes.title: Birthday

episodes.synopsis: Sensei reflects on Dog and Cat's advancing ages and hears a shocking story from her dog-loving friend.
episodes.title: A Friend's Story

episodes.synopsis: Dog and Cat have very different reactions when it's time to see the vet.
episodes.title: The Vet

episodes.synopsis: Dog is excited to be taking a new and unfamiliar route while out on a walk, but when he realizes what the destination is...
episodes.title: An Unfamiliar Road

episodes.synopsis: Dog and Cat both get some medicine, but administering it is not as easy as the vet makes it sound...
episodes.title: Medicine

episodes.synopsis: Sensei recalls the time when her childhood dog became a mother.
episodes.title: Mother

episodes.synopsis: Sensei tries out some new grooming brushes for Dog and Cat.
episodes.title: Brushing

episodes.synopsis: Sensei recalls an odd childhood habit she picked up when dining out with her family: she would secretly take the bones from her lamb roast home to give to the family dog.
episodes.title: Bones

episodes.synopsis: Dogs are notoriously light sleepers, which means you have to be careful about the noises you make...
episodes.title: I Can't Be Careless

episodes.synopsis: Sensei's mother reads the first volume of the Dog and Cat manga, and it prompts her to reflect on how much Dog and Cat have aged since it was written.
episodes.title: Dog and Cat
